claims.text: The retained repository source preserves only the title “最长连续序列长度”; it does not define whether continuity is by input position or integer value, nor input type, duplicate semantics, complexity target, language, or API.
Value-adjacency (+1), order independence, Java int[], HashSet, duplicate semantics, null/empty behavior, and non-mutation are explicit candidate choices rather than recovered prompt facts.

For the chosen contract, deduplication turns each integer value into one point; expanding only from values with no predecessor enumerates each maximal +1 consecutive run from its unique minimum without duplicate starts.
Under average O(1) HashSet operations the expected time is O(n) and extra space is O(n); the candidate explicitly does not claim strict worst-case linear time.
The exact Java fixture passes 10 fixed cases and 5000 deterministic random arrays against an independent copy-sort-deduplicate-scan oracle while confirming no input mutation.

findings: The repository source supports only the title “最长连续序列长度”; the candidate explicitly acknowledges that “连续” is ambiguous and does not claim a hidden LeetCode number, HashSet requirement, O(n) requirement, language, or API.
The candidate labels value-adjacency (+1), input-order independence, Java int[], duplicate semantics, HashSet usage, null/empty behavior, and non-mutation as implementation choices.
The start-only expansion is correct for the declared set-of-values contract: every maximal run has exactly one value with no predecessor, and duplicates are removed before counting.

Promoting int values to long prevents predecessor/successor wraparound at Integer.MIN_VALUE and Integer.MAX_VALUE; the answer also qualifies O(n) as expected under average HashSet behavior rather than strict worst-case.
The exact OpenJDK 21.0.11 fixture passed 10 fixed cases and 5000 deterministic randomized arrays against an independent sort-deduplicate-scan oracle with mutation checks.

The answer explicitly says that a contiguous-subarray interpretation would require a different solution, preserving the unresolved source ambiguity instead of hiding it; formal promotion remains blocked by the repository human-approval gate.
